source_observation: The lifecycle harness waits for avatar/runtime readiness, then performs scripted selection changes, reloads and context teardown without waiting for independently mounted card thumbnails. Its original request-failure record has no case, action or timestamp.
cause_boundary: A scripted supersession or teardown cancellation is plausible, but the original artifact cannot establish its exact trigger. A cancellation message alone is not treated as proof of a test-only cause.
correction_contract: Bounded readiness for current expected mounted card images before scripted supersession, reload and teardown.
Record case, timestamp and phase for request failures.
Keep all original behavior assertions and fail on every captured request failure or HTTP error; no cancellation allowlist and no retry.
acceptance: A complete subsequent live run must satisfy the corrected strict checks. This failed attempt remains failed.
